content: Both `:py:attr:`limit`` inside methods correctly link to their own class attribute. Fix complete and tested. searchmode==0: reordered checks to try most specific qualified name first: `modname.classname.name` if both, then `classname.name`, then `modname.name`, then bare `name`, preventing global shadowing class attribute when class context available. searchmode==1: added `classname.name` check before bare `name` fallback for type annotation/dot-prefix references to class members over globals. Fuzzy fallback: filtered by module/class context to avoid cross-module matches for same-named variables; only objects starting with `modname.` (if modname given) or `classname.`/`modname.classname.` if classname given. Next: remove backup file and finalize.
